event_chain.summary: Historical personal data files downloaded from online code repository

summary: In December 2025 the University of Sydney was alerted to suspicious activity in one of its online code libraries used for software development, which also held historical data files from a retired system. Attackers accessed and downloaded personal information (names, dates of birth, phone numbers, home addresses, job titles and employment dates) for about 10,000 current and 12,500 former staff and affiliates and about 5,000 alumni and students. The university locked down the system, notified people from December 18, 2025, and said there was no evidence the data had been used or published.
